license.notes: LICENSE is the unmodified Apache-2.0 template; the appendix line reads 'Copyright [yyyy] [name of copyright owner]' (placeholders never filled in). README badge is the generic GitHub license shield for algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve. Third-party headers: examples/tsp_tour_minimization/{initial_program,evolved_program}/include/json.hpp is nlohmann/json (MIT, 'SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2013-2023 Niels Lohmann') and bundles MIT code from Florian Loitsch, Bjoern Hoehrmann, Evan Nemerson and the Abseil Authors. language: C++ headers (14 .hpp, vendored json in an example)
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml ([build-system] requires setuptools>=42, wheel; setup.py is a stub calling setup()); Makefile wraps venv/pip install -e ., unittest, black, docker build; Dockerfile FROM python:3.12-slim with pip install -e .
interpreter_or_compiler: CPython >=3.10 per pyproject requires-python; Dockerfile uses python:3.12-slim; black/mypy target py310
dependencies: [dev] pytest>=7.0.0, pytest-asyncio>=0.21.0, black>=22.0.0, isort>=5.10.0, mypy>=0.950, requests>=2.28.0, pre-commit>=4.5.1
Makefile install-dev / README OptiLLM setup: pip install optillm (unpinned, optional proxy)
README Claude Code CLI provider: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code (unpinned, optional)
README Copilot CLI provider: npm install -g @github/copilot (unpinned, optional)
No lockfile; all version bounds are lower bounds only
network_fetches_in_setup: pip install optillm (optional proxy); Makefile test-integration also downloads model google/gemma-3-270m-it via optillm

Runtime: every iteration calls an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API (default api_base https://api.openai.com/v1 via OPENAI_API_BASE; example config points at https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/); requires OPENAI_API_KEY env var (config.py:535)
Optional embedding endpoint for novelty filtering (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY / OPENAI_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL per README)
entry_points: openevolve-run.py / openevolve/cli.py main (argparse CLI: initial_program, evaluation_file, --config, --output, --iterations, --checkpoint, --api-base, --primary-model, --secondary-model; builds Config and calls OpenEvolve.run)

openevolve/controller.py OpenEvolve (loads config, initial program, ProgramDatabase, Evaluator, PromptSampler, LLMEnsemble; run() adds the initial program, then delegates to ProcessParallelController and saves best/ output and checkpoints)

openevolve/process_parallel.py ProcessParallelController.run_evolution (async main loop: submits iterations to a ProcessPoolExecutor per island, collects SerializableResult children, adds them to the database, migrates, checkpoints, early-stops)

openevolve/process_parallel.py _run_iteration_worker (worker: rebuilds programs from a DB snapshot, builds the prompt from parent+top+inspirations+artifacts, calls LLM ensemble, applies SEARCH/REPLACE diffs or full rewrite, evaluates child, returns child Program dict)

openevolve/database.py ProgramDatabase (MAP-Elites grid keyed by feature coords, islands, archive, add/_add, sample_from_island with exploration/exploitation/random parent choice, _sample_inspirations, migrate_programs, save/load checkpoints, artifacts store)
openevolve/evaluator.py Evaluator.evaluate_program (loads user evaluator module, direct or cascade evaluation with timeouts, optional LLM feedback, captures artifacts)

openevolve/prompt/sampler.py PromptSampler.build_prompt (renders system/user prompt from templates in openevolve/prompts/defaults with evolution history, inspirations, artifacts, template stochasticity)

openevolve/api.py run_evolution / evolve_function / evolve_algorithm / evolve_code (library entry points; accept inline code and callables; optional island_selector and PopulationStrategy hooks defined in selection.py / population.py)
example_input: examples/function_minimization/initial_program.py: a random-search search_algorithm(iterations=1000, bounds=(-5,5)) for f(x,y)=sin(x)*cos(y)+sin(x*y)+(x^2+y^2)/20 inside # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START/END markers; examples/function_minimization/evaluator.py returning EvaluationResult metrics incl. combined_score; config.yaml with max_iterations 10, gemini-2.5-flash-lite/gemini-2.5-flash ensemble, 3 islands, population_size 50, archive_size 20
example_output: Per controller._save_best_program: <output_dir>/best/best_program.py plus best/best_program_info.json, and checkpoints/checkpoint_N/ directories holding the program database; README example says evolution discovers simulated annealing (global minimum approx (-1.704, 0.678), value -1.519 per examples/function_minimization/README.md)
runtime_native_deps: None required by the core (pure Python + numpy)
Network access to an LLM API is required at run time
Example-specific: Rust toolchain (rust_adaptive_sort), R (r_robust_regression), Apple Silicon + MLX (mlx_metal_kernel_opt), C++ compiler (tsp_tour_minimization), MLIR (attention_optimization)
host_class: Any CPython >=3.10 host with outbound HTTPS to an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint (or a local Ollama/vLLM/optillm server); no GPU needed for the framework; uses multiprocessing ProcessPoolExecutor
upstream_docs: @software{openevolve, title = {OpenEvolve: an open-source evolutionary coding agent}, author = {Asankhaya Sharma}, year = {2025}, publisher = {GitHub}}
No arXiv id or DOI in README/CITATION at pin
built_to: An evolutionary coding agent that uses LLMs (any OpenAI-compatible API, Claude Code CLI or Copilot CLI) to iteratively mutate a program and keep the best variants according to a user-supplied evaluator, using MAP-Elites quality-diversity, islands with migration, LLM ensembles and an artifact feedback side-channel.
pressure: README frames it against manual optimization: days-to-weeks of human-limited exploration, poor reproducibility, hard multi-objective tradeoffs and no scaling; pyproject describes it as an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve (CLAUDE.md: Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve), i.e. no open implementation existed.
success_means: README FAQ: primary metric is the evaluator's combined_score (or metric average), plus convergence of best score over time, MAP-Elites grid coverage, iterations to target, robustness across test cases; showcase claims are 2-3x kernel speedups and matching state-of-the-art n=26 circle packing.
main_loop_one_sentence: ProcessParallelController.run_evolution samples a parent and inspirations from an island (exploration from island / exploitation from archive / random, by exploration_ratio+exploitation_ratio), ships a DB snapshot to a worker that builds a prompt, calls the LLM ensemble, applies SEARCH/REPLACE diffs (or full rewrite) to the parent, evaluates the child, and returns it; the parent process adds the child to the MAP-Elites island database, migrates between islands when due, checkpoints, and repeats until max_iterations, target_score or early stopping.
behavioral_entry_point: openevolve/database.py:ProgramDatabase.sample_from_island (parent/inspiration selection) and _add/_update_archive (survival); openevolve/process_parallel.py:_run_iteration_worker (mutation via LLM + diff application); hooks exposed as openevolve/population.py:PopulationStrategy and openevolve/selection.py:IslandSelectionContext via api.run_evolution(island_selector=..., population_strategy=...)
lineage_notes: pyproject.toml description: 'Open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve'. CLAUDE.md: 'open-source implementation of Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve system'. The README at this pin does not mention AlphaEvolve, FunSearch or DeepMind by name; it cites an HF blog 'Towards Open Evolutionary Agents'. Evolution operators named in README: MAP-Elites, island model with ring-topology migration, double selection (performance vs inspiration), artifact side-channel; OptiLLM (same author) as optional proxy.
